title: Embedding Systems & Vector Engineering
description: Optimize embedding models, vector database indexing, cross-encoder reranking, and caching strategies for high-performance RAG systems.
longDescription: Go beyond basic RAG: embedding model selection and quantization, vector indexing algorithms (HNSW, IVF-PQ, ANOGA), cross-encoder reranking for precision, embedding caching and invalidation, and observability for vector database performance.
whatYouLearn: Embedding model selection and quantization tradeoffs
Vector indexing algorithms for latency vs accuracy
Cross-encoder reranking for improved retrieval precision
Vector database observability and performance monitoring
